newsitem.title: USA: Investment Technology buys stake in firm.
newsitem.headline: Investment Technology buys stake in firm.

text.p: Investment Technology Group Inc said Friday that it bought a minority stake in Advanced Investment Technology, a Florida investment company that uses specialized quantitative techniques to manage institutional assets.
A company spokesman declined to discuss terms of the transaction.

Clearwater-based Advanced Investment will continue to operate independently with its existing staff. It currently manages over $650 million in equity assets for its institutional clients, Investment Technology said.
